evidence: Has Mining label, modifies node block template management (`BlockTemplateManager`), and updates `getblocktemplate` caching behavior.
rationale: Removes process-scoped static cache variables in `getblocktemplate` in favor of managing cache lifetime in `BlockTemplateManager`. This addresses tracking issue #33758, fixes test-only lifetime issues where `CBlockIndex*` outlived `ChainstateManager`, adds compile-time thread safety annotations, and adds unit test coverage for template invalidation.
